# Feature Request

## What problem does it solve?
Describe the pain point or missing capability, not the solution.

## Who needs it?
Which usage scenario / user type would benefit?

## Proposed approach (optional)
Sketch of how it might work. Keep it high-level — implementation details can wait.

## Alternatives
What are you doing today to work around it?

## Additional context
Anything else (related issues, references, links).
